title: Languages Google publisher products support - Google Ad Manager Help

facts.fact: Google publisher products support publishers in several languages, and a site's primary language is selected during the sign-up process.
facts.quote: You can select your site's primary language during the sign-up process.

facts.fact: If a publisher is approved, Google serves relevant ads to pages in the appropriate language, even when the site contains multiple supported languages.
facts.quote: If you're approved, Google will serve relevant ads to your pages in the appropriate language, even if your site contains multiple supported languages.

facts.fact: Placing Google ad code on pages whose content is primarily in an unsupported language is not permitted by the Google Publisher Policies.
facts.quote: Placing Google ad code on pages with content primarily in an unsupported language is not permitted by the Google Publisher Policies.
